module: ImGui row shapes that the editor tool panels are made of: a slider preceded by its reset button, a label in front of a row of option buttons, and a sub-tab that closes with a separator line. Shared so the windows look alike (30 px column for the reset, labels 118 px wide). Uses the 'crystal' palette and util.beginSubTab/endSubTab.
usage:
local rows = require('editor/toolUtilities/uiRows')
rows.beginSliderRow('w', width == 4, function() width = 4 end)
im.SliderFloat('##w', widthPtr, 1, 10)
rows.endSliderRow()
notes: beginSliderRow pushes a style (GrabMinSize 20), opens 2 columns and a PushItemWidth(-1); endSliderRow must always follow to close everything.
optIcon falls back to the crop_square icon for an unknown name, because uiIconImageButton crashes on a nil icon.
mixRow accepts rows { id, tip, icon } or positional arrays { id, tip, icon }.

LABEL_COL_W.desc: Width of the label column (118), to align stacked button rows.

beginSliderRow.desc: Reset icon to the left of the slider (empty space if already at the default value). The caller draws the slider between beginSliderRow and endSliderRow.

onReset.desc: Called when the reset button is clicked.

endSliderRow.desc: Closes the slider row (width, columns, style).

rowLabel.desc: Label to the left of a button row, followed by a SameLine at a fixed X (at least the label width).

optIcon.desc: Returns the editor icon of that name, or a plain square if it is unknown.

mixRow.desc: Button row where several can be lit at the same time, for a choice that is a mix. `has(id)` tells which ones are lit. The tooltip says "In the mix" or not.

opts.desc: List of options { id, tip, icon } or positional triplets.

has.desc: has(optId) returns true if the option is lit.

returns.desc: Identifier of the clicked option, nil otherwise.

markSep.desc: Draws the closing line of a list and remembers its position, so that the sub-tab containing it does not draw a second one just below.

beginSubTab.desc: Opens a sub-tab via util.beginSubTab and resets the separator memory.

returns.desc: True if the tab is open (inferred from code).

endSubTab.desc: Closes a sub-tab with a separator line, unless the last thing drawn was already one or there is no vertical space left.
